findings.message: The generated report retains v1 notes and does not contain the v2 fitEnvelope or silhouetteRevision markers. The artifact therefore does not prove that the v2 generator executed.
The front, side, and back renders show a rigid rectangular shell with excessive clearance rather than a body-following happi silhouette.
The shoulder region remains a nearly horizontal plate and forms detached wing-like folds.
The sleeves terminate near the upper arm and fold into the shoulder instead of extending along the upper-arm/lower-arm chain.
The collar bridge and front bands visibly float above or outside the neckline and do not read as a continuous sewn route.

nextRequiredChanges: Use a stable, unversioned product build entrypoint.
Delete or quarantine stale generated outputs before each Blender execution.
Write an execution revision marker and reject artifacts whose marker does not match the requested revision.
Rebuild the shoulder, sleeve-cap, and collar geometry before another direct review.
